title: Model profiles
footer: Select a profile to inspect, edit, or apply it. Changes take effect on the next call or Agent start without modifying credentials.
none_active: No profile is in use, so Agent presets are off until you apply one.
no_tiers: No Agent presets in this profile yet.
conflict: Profiles were changed elsewhere. Your edits are kept; reload to review the latest version before saving.
active_drift: Live settings currently differ from this active profile. Update this profile from current configuration to keep them, or apply it again to re-sync.
capture_hint: Replace this profile's purpose bindings and launcher overrides with your current configuration. Agent presets stay unchanged.
conflict_capture: Profiles were changed elsewhere. Reload to get the latest version before capturing.
confirm_apply_intro: Applying {name} will update these fields in your current configuration:
confirm_reapply_intro: Applying {name} again will overwrite your current live changes for these fields:
confirm_switch_active_drift_only: Switching to {target} matches your current settings, but {active} still has unsaved changes:
confirm_active_drift: Your current configuration differs from the active profile ({active}). Capture it first so switching back does not overwrite these fields:
confirm_capture_active_hint: You can also capture the current configuration into {active} before switching.
apply_failed_after_capture: Saved current configuration into {active}, but applying failed: {error}
save_note_inactive: Saving updates this profile template without changing your active models. Apply the profile afterwards to switch. Credentials are never shown or modified here.
save_note_active: Saving updates this active profile. Agent presets apply on the next Agent start; purpose and launcher changes take effect when you apply this profile again. Credentials are never shown or modified here.
name: Profile name
description_placeholder: Optional note on when to use this profile
purposes_hint: Choose which model categories this profile sets when applied. Unchecked categories stay unchanged on switch.
no_purposes: This profile does not change any purpose bindings.
launchers_hint: Override model fields of providers added in Persona when this profile is applied. Credentials, URLs, and headers are never touched.
no_launchers: This profile does not override any launcher model fields.
no_more_launchers: All managed providers are already listed.
launcher_api_only_model: Direct API providers only support overriding their main model here.
tiers_hint: Named launch presets available to Persona and New Agent when this profile is active.
trial_summary: Last {days} days: {dispatches} dispatched, {would_switch} would have switched
trial_definition: Counts dispatches where this inactive profile would have picked a different launcher or model than the active one.
err_name: Profile name is required (at most {max} characters, single line).
err_description: Description must be at most {max} characters.
err_launcher_model: Main model for {launcher} cannot be empty; remove the override to leave it unchanged.
err_launcher_api: {launcher} is a Direct API provider and only supports overriding its main model ({field} must be empty).
err_tiers_limit: At most {max} Agent presets are allowed per profile.
err_tier_name: Preset name "{tier}" must start with a lowercase letter and use only a-z, 0-9, _ or - (max 24 chars).
err_tier_description: Preset "{tier}" description must be a single line of at most {max} characters.
err_tier_candidates_empty: Preset "{tier}" needs at least one candidate.
err_tier_candidate_model: Invalid model ID "{model}" for preset "{tier}" candidate #{index}.
empty_hint: Model profiles are optional. Your direct Model Configuration below applies as-is until you create and apply a profile.
create_note: Captures your current live model configuration and Agent presets into a new saved profile without activating it or changing your running models.
profile_id_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores (up to 32 characters).
err_id: Profile ID must start with a lowercase letter or number, use only a-z, 0-9, _ or - (max 32 chars), and cannot be "rollback".
err_id_duplicate: A profile with ID "{id}" already exists.
conflict_create: Profiles were changed elsewhere. Reloaded the latest list — review and try creating again.
deactivate_hint: Turning off the active profile disables Agent presets while keeping your current live model settings unchanged.
deactivated: Active profile turned off. Live model settings unchanged.
unsupported_deactivate: This hub does not support turning off the active profile yet. Update the hub and try again.
confirm_delete_inactive: This will permanently remove the saved profile "{name}". Your current live model settings will stay unchanged.
confirm_delete_active: This will permanently remove the active profile "{name}" and turn off its Agent presets. Your current live model settings will stay unchanged.
conflict_delete: Profiles were changed elsewhere. Reloaded the latest list — review and try deleting again.
unsupported_delete: This hub does not support deleting this profile yet. Update the hub and try again.
confirm_clear_all_body: This will permanently remove all saved model profiles ({count}) and switch rollback history, and turn off any active profile and Agent presets. Your current live model settings will stay unchanged.
confirm_clear_all_rollbacks_only: This will permanently remove saved switch rollback history. Your current live model settings will stay unchanged.
cleared_all: Cleared all model profiles. Live model settings unchanged.
conflict_clear: Profiles were changed elsewhere. Reloaded the latest list — review and try clearing again.
unsupported_clear: This hub does not support clearing all model profiles yet. Update the hub and try again.
